Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function acos() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultACos  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).acos (); // creates a UnaryACosUGen

You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 

 UGen resultACos  =  acos(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryACosUGen
See also:
